question: By whose agency and will does the yoginī named Icchā extend up to Māyā?
premises: Supreme will extends up to Māyā
inference: Through the siddhas and by supreme will, the yoginī Icchā reaches up to Māyā.
uncertainties: The verbal action is implicit and not explicitly stated.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, by the siddhas and by supreme will, extends up to Māyā.
